servicesSummary: VTA Telecom Corporation and Viettel McDermott has provided legal services to VTA Telecom Corporation Group and Viettel Group regarding U.S. export and trade compliance since December 2016. This legal representation is ongoing and exempt from FARA disclosure. During the reporting period, McDermott communicated with counsel from the Departments of State and Commerce regarding VTA Telecom's pending administrative review at these agencies.
moneyExplanation: The supplemental statement reports $305.00 in total disbursements for this registrant during the filing period. These are registrant-level filing totals and are not automatically attributable to any one foreign principal.
extractionMethod: Text of the original DOJ FARA supplemental filing; source-verified structured extraction
coverage: Registrant-level filing totals are reported only when the form provides an explicit total. Itemized financial rows require an exact known principal, real date, counterparty, purpose and amount. U.S. political contacts require an itemized principal/date/contact/method/purpose row. No payment to a politician or principal-specific share is inferred.
